summary: Lifecore Biomedical filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026, noting that on September 27, 2026 it entered an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Lifecore Inc. and Hazel Merger Sub, Inc., under which the registrant is the target. The board set November 4, 2026 as the record date for a special stockholders' meeting to approve adoption of the merger agreement and the merger itself. No price per share, premium, or deal value was disclosed in this excerpt, and no financial advisor is named. The company will file a preliminary and definitive proxy statement; what to watch is the proxy's fairness opinion and vote threshold.
